new.name: defender-bypass-winrar-cve-2023-38831
new.description: The purpose of this lab is to empirically demonstrate that relying solely on the free, built-in Microsoft Defender Antivirus is insufficient for small businesses. While free Defender provides baseline endpoint protection, it lacks the operational capabilities, patching, and 24/7 monitoring required to stop modern, multi-stage attacks.
